disease.name: Cardiovascular disease (CVD)
disease.full_name: Cardiovascular disease — composite category covering ischemic stroke (TOAST etiology subtypes), pulmonary arterial hypertension (heritable + idiopathic), aortic dissection, and bicuspid aortic valve with ascending aorta dilation. Framework architecture is extensible to coronary heart disease, heart failure, and hypertensive heart disease in v0.3+.
disease.global_burden: Leading global cause of mortality (~17.9M deaths/year per WHO 2023). Ischemic heart disease and stroke are the top two causes of death worldwide.
disease.primary_sites: Heart, vasculature (endothelium, smooth muscle), brain (in stroke).
tissue_classes_engaged: stromal (vascular endothelial, peri-vascular adipose, smooth muscle)

I27.0 — Primary pulmonary hypertension (tested via VAL-109 GSE84395 cultured PECs, idiopathic PAH n=11)
I27.2 — Other secondary pulmonary hypertension (heritable PAH covered by VAL-109, n=10)

cookbook_master_readme: README_MASTER_v2_4.md (current); cardio-epic v0.2 ships under v2_4 master.
validation_tier_rationale: VAL-108 + VAL-109 + VAL-110 tested cardio-epic across THREE independent public cohorts spanning THREE distinct measurement substrates (GenomeStudio AVG_Beta whole blood, minfi preprocessFunnorm cultured PECs, GenomeStudio V2011.1 aortic tissue) and FOUR distinct cardiovascular pathologies (ischemic stroke 3-subtype, heritable PAH, idiopathic PAH, aortic dissection, BAV+dilation). VAL-109 demonstrated direct vascular-tile discrimination (Vascular_endothelial_cells d=+0.79 control vs hPAH on cultured PECs). VAL-110 demonstrated Stage 1 immune discrimination of aortic pathology (d=+1.08 normal vs BAV). VAL-108 documented the framework's correct null finding that whole-blood methylation does not stratify ischemic stroke etiology. VAL-111 added EpiSCORE HeartRef atlas integration test on the same three β panels — sealed at O3_TISSUE_FLOOR_DOMINATED, atlas → atlases_deferred for v0.3, no change to VAL-108/109/110 sealed structural results. Combined evidence supports a multi-modal validation tier: framework discriminates cardiovascular disease vs healthy on multiple substrates with biology-appropriate signal envelope, correctly reports nulls where biology is homogenized, and honestly defers atlases that do not transfer at the substrate resolutions tested.

atlases_deferred.atlas_full_name: Konigsberg 2023 cardiovascular 28-cell-type atlas (NAR Genomics & Bioinformatics, doi:10.1093/nargab/lqad061), sorted cardiomyocytes + cardiac fibroblasts + vascular endothelial + smooth muscle
atlases_deferred.evaluation_anchor_val: (none yet — atlas not acquired; this is the canonical-document-named cardio Stage 2 atlas per PIPELINE_REFERENCE Part 2.4)
atlases_deferred.deferral_rationale: PIPELINE_REFERENCE_v2.md Part 2.4 explicitly states: 'Without this atlas, cardio-epic cannot be deployed.' Konigsberg 2023 includes sorted cardiomyocytes (terminal class, H_min = 0.7728) — currently invisible to the layered Moss+Loyfer chain because Moss has no sorted cardiomyocyte entry and Loyfer has only Left_atrium bulk. Cardiomyocyte cfDNA elevation has known signal in MI, heart failure, myocarditis (Zemmour 2018 Nat Commun, doi:10.1038/s41467-018-03961-y). VAL-111's EpiSCORE HeartRef test was a side-track from the canonical cardio atlas path; Konigsberg is the document-named blocker.
atlases_deferred.unblock_dependency: Phase A: acquire Konigsberg 2023 atlas. Phase B: Konigsberg-specific calibration VAL (CHK-3.1A baseline + CHK-3.1B cardio-subset threshold) on a structurally-separated healthy cohort BEFORE any cardio-cohort scoring against this atlas (CCL-041 platform calibration discipline). Phase C: cardio-cohort scoring VAL on GSE69138 + GSE84395 + GSE84274 + ideally CHD/MI cohort (GSE56046 MESA n=1,202 EPIC-era ROS/MAP).

atlases_deferred.deferral_rationale: Different from EpiSCORE HeartRef (which was scored in VAL-111). The pan-tissue version covers 13 solid tissues including Heart, Kidney, Liver, Lung, Breast, Brain — relevant for differential diagnosis when Stage 1 fires. atlases_deferred.atlas_full_name: Tanaka 2025 6-cell-type neural cfDNA atlas (medRxiv 10.1101/2025.10.07.25337503v2), nanopore methylation: cortical neurons + dopaminergic + spinal motor + astrocytes + Schwann + microglia
atlases_deferred.deferral_rationale: PIPELINE_REFERENCE_v2.md Part 2.5 calls this 'highest-priority new addition' — relevant to cardio-epic because cardiac inflammation reads through astrocyte/microglia signatures and the differential between cardiovascular and neurodegenerative contributors to a Stage 1 immune signal benefits from neural cell-type discrimination. Caveat: nanopore-based atlas, not array-indexed by default — 450K/EPIC integration requires mapping cell-type-discriminating regions to array CpGs, similar to how Loyfer team built array-indexed reference_atlas.csv from WGBS Loyfer 2023 atlas. Tractable but a v0.3+ task.
atlases_deferred.unblock_dependency: Phase A: nanopore→array CpG bridge engineering. Phase B: calibration VAL on structurally-separated healthy cohort. Phase C: cardio-cohort scoring.

atlases_deferred.atlas_full_name: Liu 2023 single-cell brain methylation atlas (Science, doi:10.1126/science.adf5357), 188 cell types from 517K single human brain cells across 46 regions
atlases_deferred.deferral_rationale: PIPELINE_REFERENCE_v2.md Part 2.6 documents Liu 2023 as v0.4+ candidate. Granularity exceeds clinical-array deconvolution (single-cell barcodes), but cell-type-discriminating CpG sets (scMCodes) can be projected onto 450K/EPIC. Relevance to cardio: brain↔heart axis in cardiovascular disease (autonomic modulation, post-stroke neural inflammation). Lower priority for cardio than Konigsberg/Tanaka/Caggiano.
atlases_deferred.unblock_dependency: Phase A: scMCodes→array CpG projection engineering. Phase B: calibration VAL. Phase C: cardio-cohort scoring (lower priority).

atlases_deferred.atlas_full_name: Zhu et al. EpiSCORE HeartRef subpanel (Nat Commun 2022 13:3895), 3,727 unique 450K CpGs × 5 cardiac cell types (CM/EC/FB/MP/SMC), GPL-2 license
atlases_deferred.deferral_rationale: Promoter-based reference: gene-promoter substrate insufficient for A-score tile discrimination on heterogeneous β panels at current bridging resolution. All five cardiac tile A-scores read 0.46–0.51 across all three cohorts (GSE69138 stroke blood n=589, GSE84395 PAH PEC n=39, GSE84274 aortic tissue n=24); maximum within-cohort tissue discrimination range = 0.0152 (GSE84274 MP tile, dissection 0.5012 − normal 0.4860); blood-floor breach on 5/5 tiles in GSE69138. Direction biologically sensible but A-score magnitude set by gene-promoter average methylation rather than cell-of-origin contrast. Atlas methodologically sound for EpiDISH proportion estimation; does not transfer to A-score tile reading on heterogeneous β. Note: this is the SUB-PANEL (HeartRef sub-set of the EpiSCORE family); the pan-tissue version is a separate atlases_deferred entry above.
atlases_deferred._v0_2_patch_note: VAL-111 was a side-track from the canonical-document path. PIPELINE_REFERENCE Part 2.4 names Konigsberg 2023 as the cardio Stage 2 atlas blocker, not EpiSCORE HeartRef. EpiSCORE HeartRef was selected because it sat in atlas_vault, not because it was the document-prescribed cardio atlas. CCL-044 / DISC-CARDIO-007 logged this as a process lesson; CHK-5.12 atlas-canonical-source-check gate added to TESTING_CHECKLIST to prevent recurrence.
atlases_deferred.unblock_dependency: Either (a) alternative bridging from gene-promoter integer marker IDs to a tile-coverage CpG layout that preserves cell-type contrast on heterogeneous β; or (b) supersession by Konigsberg 2023 + Caggiano CelFiE TIM cardiac integrations, which would render this sub-panel non-essential.

substrate_roadmap._purpose: CHK-5.9 structural-parity block. EDEAR's five-substrate substrate roadmap. Each substrate has status, validation anchor, target card version, and rationale. Cardio-epic v0.2 is methylation-only; the four non-DNAm substrates are roadmapped to v0.3+ as the multi-substrate assay generations come online.

DNAm_methylation_β.validation_anchor: VAL-108 + VAL-109 + VAL-110 + VAL-111 (4-VAL chain across 3 cohorts, 3 substrates, 4 pathologies, plus 1 atlas-deferral test)
DNAm_methylation_β.rationale: DNA methylation β is the production substrate at v0.2. Substrate-specific CHK-3.1A self-cal envelopes documented for three distinct β preprocessing pipelines (TCGA HM450K sesame Level 3, GenomeStudio AVG_Beta HM450K, minfi preprocessFunnorm HM450K, GenomeStudio V2011.1 raw). Cardio-epic's only validated substrate at v0.2.

chk_3_1_thresholds_per_substrate._purpose: CHK-5.10 structural-parity block. BOTH CHK-3.1A (full-genome substrate gate) AND CHK-3.1B (card-specific marker subset gate) thresholds for every measurement substrate cardio-epic has been validated against. Cardio-epic v0.1 was the first card built natively under the CHK-3.1A/B split convention (CCL-042); v0.2 inherits and documents the per-substrate threshold table in this block.

stage_1_immune_flag.scoring_method: Pooled-entropy A-score against H_min(immune); A = H_observed - H_min

validated_substrates.finding: Stage 1 d < 0.17 across all stroke etiology pairs — etiology-equivalent in whole blood (not a framework failure; biology-correct null per LL-CARDIO-002)
Stage 1 d = +0.65 control vs hPAH and control vs iPAH; strong PAH detection on cultured cells
Stage 1 d = +0.56 normal vs dissection; d = +1.08 normal vs BAV — strongest aortic discrimination at v0.2

stage_1_immune_flag.deployment_policy: Stage 1 immune A-score is the primary discriminator for cardio-epic across all validated substrates. Pure-cell substrates (PECs, cardiomyocyte) and bulk-tissue substrates (aorta) both show Stage 1 differentiation; whole-blood does not stratify etiology but does anchor the pooled inflammatory signature.

Cardio-epic v0.2 reporting filters non-cardio tile signals from bulk-aortic interpretation.
stage_2_localization.epiSCORE_heartRef_v0_2_disposition: Atlas evaluated under VAL-111 (sealed 2026-04-29) on the same three cohorts as VAL-108/109/110. Outcome O3_TISSUE_FLOOR_DOMINATED: all five cardiac tile A-scores read 0.46–0.51 regardless of substrate; max within-cohort tissue discrimination 0.0152; blood-floor breach on 5/5 tiles. EpiSCORE HeartRef → atlases_deferred for v0.3 (see atlases_used_and_deferred block). VAL-108/109/110 sealed structural results stand; VAL-111 demonstrates that adding a gene-promoter cardiac reference atlas does not provide additional tile discrimination at the substrate resolutions tested.

universal_reference._purpose: Self-contained reference block embedded in every EDEAR disease card. Full-inline Option B: do not rely on README_MASTER or any external file for pipeline invariants. A new analyst loading only this card + GAPE_WEB_v13.py must be able to reproduce the full Stage 1 + Stage 2 + Stage 3 pipeline without reading anything else.

universal_stage_1_pipeline.invariant_rule: Every patient's first test is identical regardless of suspected disease: Stage 1 is always immune-class on buffy-coat DNA using the Xu-538 panel with H_min(immune) = 0.838889. This applies to every EDEAR card. What varies per card: expected direction, Stage 2 tissue target, tier thresholds, mandatory covariates, clinical action paths.
universal_stage_1_pipeline.specimen: buffy coat DNA (peripheral blood leukocytes, ~70% immune cells)
universal_stage_1_pipeline.panel_source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020;112(1):87-94
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_primary: pooled entropy A-score = mean(H(β)/H_min) across panel
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_secondary_for_bidirection: directional A_dir = mean(direction_i × z_i) when disease drives bidirectional per-CpG drift. Applicable to AD via 7-CpG Rule A panel. Cardio-epic v0.2 uses pooled entropy as primary (no bidirectional cancellation pattern observed in cardio cohorts).

universal_h_min_table._note: Class H_min constants from GAPE_WEB_v13.py lines 87-96. Frozen at G-003b MCMC posterior means, R-hat < 1.001. Used at Stage 2 to compute per-tissue A-scores from deconvolved β values.

universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution of the Stage 1 IDAT into 18 per-tissue β values
universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.production_module_status: G-DECONV-001 OPEN-DEFERRED. VAL-041 proved the workflow at published-β level (10/10 top-1 correct localization across 10 cancer types). Production per-IDAT deployment requires: (1) 30 MB Moss 2018 reference matrix locked into the repo; (2) Salas 2018 QC harness implemented; (3) assay version tag (L1 Illumina EPIC + Moss markers, L2 custom capture panel, L3 full 5-substrate MESA+DELFI).

universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.method: Teschendorff 2017 EpiDISH RPC mode, Salas 2018 reference
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.when_applied: Runs when Stage 1 flags AND Stage 2 returns no solid-organ localization. Distinguishes chronic inflammation (neutrophil shift), hematologic immune drift (lymphocyte composition shift), autoimmune patterns, AD-type patterns (brain tissue not in buffy coat), cardiovascular inflammatory homogenization (post-stroke per LL-CARDIO-002).
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.qc_gate_rule: IDATs outside Salas bounds get QC flag; Stage 2 output not released

universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._purpose: Age-decade mean and SD of pooled-entropy immune-class A-score in healthy reference cohorts. Used to compute age-matched percentile for Stage 1 tier calls. Applies to every card's NORMAL / MARGINAL / DETECTABLE tier logic.
_sources: Hannum 2013 Mol Cell (GSE40279 blood methylation aging)
Roadmap Epigenomics Consortium 2015 Nature (127 reference epigenomes)
universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._critical_caveat_cross_cohort: This baseline is derived from the source cohorts using standard preprocessing (primarily minfi/sesame normalization). Cohorts with different preprocessing pipelines (e.g. Ferrari 2014 GSE53740 with ComBat + quantile normalization, or GenomeStudio AVG_Beta GSE69138 stroke cohort, or minfi preprocessFunnorm GSE84395 PEC cohort) can show cohort-level batch offsets of +2 SD or more relative to this baseline. Any cardio-epic deployment on a non-AIBL/non-AddNeuroMed-equivalent cohort requires either (a) re-anchoring to within-cohort HC, or (b) a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale. Do not assume universal applicability of these constants across preprocessing pipelines.

universal_tier_thresholds._source: 80-cell healthy baseline reference; same across breast-epic, crc-epic, ad-immune, lung-epic, cardio-epic
universal_tier_thresholds._note: Per-card tier thresholds MAY deviate from these universals if disease-specific literature justifies. When they deviate, the card MUST cite the deviation explicitly. Silent deviation is forbidden.

BELOW_NORMAL.A_threshold: ≤ −1.0 SD below within-cohort or 80-cell age-decade healthy reference mean
BELOW_NORMAL.action: Surface for clinician differential review; non-disease-of-card differentials (immunosuppression, post-chemo / post-transplant, primary immunodeficiency, marrow infiltration, PSP/CBD architectural homogenization). NOT silenced.

NORMAL.action: No action; serial-sample per screening cadence

URGENT.action: Run Stage 2; expedited workup per disease card

FLOOR_BREACH.action: Run Stage 2; urgent clinical workup regardless of localization

universal_sex_stratification_rule.rule: Every card's deployment MUST stratify reports by sex when sex-differential signal has been documented in validation. Cardio-epic v0.2 has not documented sex-differential signal in any of VAL-108/109/110/111 (cohort sizes too small to power sex-stratified inference; PAH cohort GSE84395 was 100% female-skewed by design, aortic GSE84274 was 22 male / 2 female). Sex stratification is recommended in deployment reports even where no sex-differential has been documented at v0.2, since absence of evidence is not evidence of absence — and sex is a known modifier of cardiovascular risk in clinical literature.
universal_sex_stratification_rule.minimum_reporting: Report must include patient sex. Card scoring MAY differ by sex if documented in validation.

universal_language_discipline.rationale: Every report must present EDEAR output as a flag that changes downstream workup, never as a diagnosis. Final diagnosis requires clinical assessment plus standard-of-care workup (imaging, tissue biopsy, ECG, echocardiogram, cardiac MRI, troponins, etc.) per the relevant clinical guidelines.

universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning._discovered_in: VAL-057 (2026-04-24); reinforced in cardio sprint by substrate-equivalence test against TCGA HM450K sesame Level 3 confirming 24-percentage-point f_extreme distribution gap (32% GenomeStudio AVG_Beta vs 56% sesame Level 3).
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.description: Cohort-level preprocessing artifacts can shift pooled-entropy A-score by +2 SD or more relative to the 80-cell Cookbook baseline. This is a systematic offset, not a biological finding. Applies to any new cohort before its baseline can be used for cross-cohort comparison.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.example: GSE69138 stroke cohort (GenomeStudio AVG_Beta): full-genome f_extreme 31.81% vs TCGA HM450K sesame Level 3 baseline 55.87% — different substrate, different threshold. GSE53740 (Ferrari 2014, 450K + ComBat + quantile normalization): HC mean A_age_z = +2.306 vs 80-cell immune baseline.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.deployment_rule: (1) On AIBL or AddNeuroMed-equivalent preprocessing: 80-cell baseline usable directly. (2) On any other cohort: re-anchor to within-cohort HC for tier thresholds OR run a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale before applying Cookbook tier thresholds. (3) Cardio-epic v0.2 specifically: substrate-specific CHK-3.1A self-cal envelopes are documented per cohort/substrate (see chk_3_1_thresholds_per_substrate block); none are generalizable until structurally-separated calibration VALs land.

universal_no_fabrication_rule.rule: Every numeric value, CpG ID, cohort size, validation result, or citation in this card traces to a primary source or a SHA-locked validation run. Nothing is invented or estimated. If a value is a projection or estimate, it is explicitly labeled as such in its field.

card_specific: LL-CARDIO-001: Substrate-cell match matters. Vascular_endothelial_cells tile reads endothelial methylation when sample IS endothelial cells (VAL-109 cultured PECs d=+0.79); reads SMC/fibroblast when sample IS bulk aorta (VAL-110 d=−0.04). Cardio-epic deployment must communicate tile-substrate fitness to customers.

LL-CARDIO-002: Whole blood does not stratify stroke etiology. Post-stroke inflammatory homogenization is a real biological phenomenon. Cardio-epic v0.2 reports stroke as a single signature, not by TOAST etiology. The framework correctly does not stratify what biology has homogenized.
LL-CARDIO-003: hPAH > iPAH framework signal is consistent with germline genetic component. Future PAH cards may stratify by genetic vs idiopathic when biology supports.

LL-CARDIO-004: Aortic Stage 2 vascular tile fails on bulk tissue (cell mismatch); Stage 1 immune A-score is the strong aortic discriminator. The framework's Stage 1 universal immune flag works on aortic tissue.

LL-CARDIO-005 (NEW in v0.2): Atlas-substrate match matters at Stage 2. Gene-promoter reference atlases (EpiSCORE-class, designed for EpiDISH proportion estimation in tissue) do not transfer to A-score tile reading on heterogeneous β panels. The atlas family that works at cardio-epic Stage 2 scoring is the tile-coverage WGBS-derived family (Loyfer 25-tile, Caggiano CelFiE TIM). VAL-111 sealed this lesson with EpiSCORE HeartRef across three cohorts and three substrates: max within-cohort tissue discrimination 0.0152 vs 0.10 threshold; blood-floor breach 5/5 tiles; gene-promoter average methylation cluster ~0.5 across heterogeneous β regardless of substrate.

lessons_discovered_v0_2._purpose: Section consolidating what was discovered or learned during the cardio-epic sprint (VAL-108 through VAL-111 plus calibration anchors VAL-106/107). This is the v0.2-specific 'what we learned' section.

what_we_discovered.name: Stage 1 immune A-score is the workhorse for cardio-epic across all substrates tested
what_we_discovered.evidence: Three out of three substrate-validated cohorts (whole blood VAL-108, cultured PECs VAL-109, aortic tissue VAL-110) produced interpretable Stage 1 readings. The strongest single cardio-epic signal we have is VAL-110 normal vs BAV at d=+1.08 — and it came from Stage 1 immune A-score on bulk aortic tissue, not from a cardio-specific Stage 2 tile. This is consistent with Stage 1 being the universal immune-class flag (per universal_stage_1_pipeline) and tells us that systemic methylation drift, picked up on the immune panel even when the sample is not blood, is the primary cardio-epic discriminator at v0.2.
what_we_discovered.implication: Cardio-epic Stage 1 carries most of the discrimination weight at v0.2. Stage 2 cardio-tiles add localization context but are not load-bearing for the headline call. Future cardio-epic cards (v0.3+) should preserve Stage 1 as the primary axis and treat Stage 2 cardiac-tile contributions as localization modifiers.

what_we_discovered.name: Substrate-cell match is the single most important cardio biology consideration
what_we_discovered.evidence: VAL-109 cultured PEC Vascular_endothelial_cells tile d=+0.79 vs VAL-110 bulk aorta Vascular_endothelial_cells tile d=−0.04. Same tile, same atlas, same H_min — different sample composition. The cultured PECs are pure endothelial cells; bulk aorta is dominated by smooth muscle and fibroblasts with endothelial cells as a minority cell type. The Stage 2 tile reads what is actually in the sample. Same finding cuts in different directions across the cohort: in VAL-110, the Adipocytes tile fires d=−0.88 normal vs BAV because the bulk aorta sample includes peri-aortic adipose tissue, and the non-cardio tiles (Hepatocytes d=−3.64, Lung_cells d=−3.25) fire because of the same peri-aortic adipose contamination signature.
what_we_discovered.implication: Cardio-epic deployment reports MUST include a tile-substrate fitness flag. The customer needs to know: this tile is operational on cultured endothelial cells; this tile is NOT operational on bulk aorta because bulk aorta has minority endothelial content. EDEAR commercial deployment uses single-pipeline patient-vs-internal-reference scoring (CCL-037), so in practice the substrate is known at the report-generation step. The fitness flag is a clinician-facing label, not a deployment limitation.

what_we_discovered.name: Biology-correct nulls are first-class outcomes
what_we_discovered.evidence: VAL-108 sealed at O3_CARDIO_EPIC_3SUBTYPE_UNDIFFERENTIATED. Maximum |d| across all stages and contrasts on n=404 ischemic stroke whole blood: 0.167. The framework correctly reports that whole-blood DNA methylation does not stratify ischemic stroke by TOAST etiology — because by the time blood is drawn post-stroke, the systemic inflammatory response has homogenized the immune methylation signature across etiologies. This is real biology, not framework failure.
what_we_discovered.implication: Cookbook discipline now treats biology-correct nulls as first-class outcomes. Cardio-epic v0.2 reports stroke as a single pooled signature, not by TOAST etiology. The framework correctly does not stratify what biology has homogenized.

what_we_discovered.name: Atlas family matters — tile-coverage atlases ≠ gene-promoter atlases at Stage 2 scoring
what_we_discovered.evidence: VAL-111 ran EpiSCORE HeartRef (gene-promoter cardiac reference, 3,727 unique 450K CpGs × 5 cardiac cell types) on the same three cohorts already sealed under VAL-108/109/110. Outcome O3_TISSUE_FLOOR_DOMINATED: all five cardiac tile A-scores read 0.46–0.51 across all three substrates regardless of cohort. Maximum within-cohort tissue discrimination 0.0152 (GSE84274 MP, dissection vs normal); EC range in GSE84395 cultured PEC 0.0070; SMC range in GSE84274 0.0120 — all an order of magnitude below the 0.10 discrimination threshold. Blood-floor breach on 5/5 tiles in GSE69138 (cohort means 0.48–0.51, well above 0.10). Yet the direction was biologically sensible (dissection > BAV+dilation > normal monotonic in GSE84274, SMC tile always highest in aortic samples, iPAH > hPAH > control on EC tile in GSE84395).
what_we_discovered.implication: Gene-promoter reference atlases like EpiSCORE are methodologically sound for their design purpose (EpiDISH proportion estimation in tissue) but do not transfer to A-score tile reading on heterogeneous β panels. The atlas family that works at cardio-epic Stage 2 scoring is the tile-coverage WGBS-derived family (Loyfer 25-tile validated; Caggiano CelFiE TIM cardiac panels candidate when HM450 hg19 manifest acquisition unblocks). EpiSCORE HeartRef → atlases_deferred for v0.3 with explicit unblock dependency. This was registered as LL-CARDIO-005.

what_we_discovered.name: Substrate-specific CHK-3.1A self-cal envelopes work for cardio at v0.2 — and they are not a generalizable platform threshold yet
what_we_discovered.evidence: Three different β preprocessing pipelines produced three different cohort f_extreme distributions: GenomeStudio AVG_Beta GSE69138 whole blood 31.81% ± 3.54%; GenomeStudio V2011.1 GSE84274 aortic 33.95% ± 2.21%; minfi preprocessFunnorm GSE84395 cultured PECs 52.82% ± 2.33%. Compared against the TCGA HM450K sesame Level 3 baseline (55.87% ± 2.44% from VAL-106), the substrate-equivalence test confirms a 24-percentage-point distribution gap between GenomeStudio AVG_Beta and sesame Level 3 — different substrates need different thresholds. Within each cohort/substrate, self-cal QC pass rates were 94–96%, so the within-cohort envelope is a working operational gate.
what_we_discovered.implication: Cardio-epic v0.2 uses substrate-specific CHK-3.1A self-cal envelopes at the within-cohort level. These are NOT generalizable platform thresholds yet. To make any of these substrate envelopes generalizable, a structurally-separated calibration VAL is required for each substrate (a separate cohort using the same preprocessing pipeline, ideally adjacent-normal tissue from a non-cardiovascular disease, to anchor the threshold without disease-driven distribution shift). This is documented in the v0.2 next_validation_steps.

what_we_discovered.name: The cardio sprint exercised the entire CHK-3.1A/B split convention end-to-end for the first time
what_we_discovered.evidence: Cardio-epic v0.1 was the first card built natively under the CHK-3.1A/B split convention (CCL-042 LL-CHK-3.1-A/B-SPLIT formalized 2026-04-28). VAL-106 established CHK-3.1A baseline for TCGA HM450K sesame Level 3 (extreme≥50.5%, middle≤9.0%, n_valid≥400,000). VAL-107 established CHK-3.1B for cardio-epic on the same substrate (extreme≥55.0%, middle≤8.5%, n_subset_valid≥7,000 of 8,100 — subset SHA `5a00e29ace75daae5a...`). VAL-108/109/110 then operated under the split with substrate-specific self-cal envelopes for the three non-sesame substrates encountered. VAL-111 added an atlas integration test on top.
what_we_discovered.implication: The split convention works in practice. Phase 4 retroactive review of breast-epic v2.3 / crc-epic v2.4 / hcc / cervical / kidney / lung / ad-immune cards (additive documentation only, no sealed VAL outcomes change) will bring the rest of the cookbook into alignment with what cardio-epic established. CHK-5.7/5.8/5.9/5.10 structural-parity gates were added to TESTING_CHECKLIST.md to lock the universal_reference + atlases_used_and_deferred + substrate_roadmap + chk_3_1_thresholds_per_substrate blocks at every card publish.

what_we_discovered.name: Always read PIPELINE_REFERENCE Part 2 first — atlas selection must trace to a canonical-document name, not 'whatever sits in atlas_vault'
what_we_discovered.evidence: VAL-111 was scored against EpiSCORE HeartRef because that atlas was already in atlas_vault from a prior acquisition pass. PIPELINE_REFERENCE_v2.md Part 2.4 explicitly names Konigsberg 2023 — NOT EpiSCORE — as the cardio Stage 2 atlas blocker, with the deployment-of-record statement: 'Without this atlas, cardio-epic cannot be deployed.' Part 2.5 names Tanaka 2025 as 'highest-priority new addition.' Part 2.7 names Caggiano CelFiE for cardiac tissue. None of these were prioritized in cardio v0.1/v0.2 because the atlas selection was made by browsing atlas_vault rather than by reading the canonical document. VAL-111 produced a real and useful negative result (atlas-family-fitness lesson, LL-CARDIO-005), but it was a side-track from the canonical cardio atlas critical path.
what_we_discovered.implication: Before any future atlas integration VAL is sealed, the prereg must cite which canonical-document section names the atlas as a production candidate. CHK-5.12 atlas-canonical-source-check gate added to TESTING_CHECKLIST.md to enforce this. Cardio v0.3 critical path: Konigsberg 2023 first, Caggiano CelFiE TIM cardiac second (when manifest unblocks), EpiSCORE pan-tissue third (separate from the HeartRef sub-panel scored in VAL-111), Tanaka 2025 fourth (when nanopore→array bridge is engineered). Each of these atlases needs its own calibration VAL (CHK-3.1A + CHK-3.1B) on a structurally-separated healthy cohort BEFORE any cardio-cohort scoring against it (CCL-041 platform calibration discipline applied to atlases, not just substrates).

what_we_chose_not_to_claim: We did not claim stroke etiology stratification (VAL-108 demonstrated etiology-equivalence in whole blood — biology-correct null per LL-CARDIO-002).
We did not claim heritable-vs-idiopathic PAH discrimination (VAL-109 demonstrated framework-equivalence; hPAH framework signal stronger than iPAH but not at the level of operational stratification).
We did not claim aortic dissection vs BAV+dilation discrimination (VAL-110 demonstrated framework-equivalence between the two pathological etiologies; both distinguishable from normal).
We did not claim that EpiSCORE HeartRef adds Stage 2 cardiac-tile discrimination at v0.2 (VAL-111 sealed at O3_TISSUE_FLOOR_DOMINATED; atlas → atlases_deferred for v0.3).

We did not claim a generalizable platform threshold for GenomeStudio AVG_Beta, GenomeStudio V2011.1, or minfi preprocessFunnorm substrates (within-cohort self-cal only at v0.2; structurally-separated calibration VALs pending).
We did not run any retroactive threshold accommodation (CCL-041 lesson honored). Each VAL's threshold was sealed in prereg before β access; outcomes were honored even when they triggered O3 or O5.

commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali._purpose: Per CCL-037 LL-CROSS-COHORT-CALIBRATION (signed off 2026-04-28), the cross-cohort calibration boundary applies exclusively to retrospective cookbook validation. EDEAR commercial deployment uses a single calibrated pipeline against a fixed reference distribution and is unaffected by the validation-side limitations documented in this card.
commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali.deployment_architecture: One partner lab generates the patient IDAT through a single calibrated normalization protocol. That same partner lab has, during L1 onboarding, run a calibration anchor batch that aligns their β-value output to the public Loyfer/Moss reference frame. Every patient's IDAT runs through that same pipeline. Every patient is compared to the same calibrated reference distribution per substrate.
commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali.first_patient_calibration: No cold-start problem. The Loyfer 25-tile array atlas IS the healthy reference (built from sorted purified cells across 25 healthy human tissues, not patient data). H_min values are frozen from MCMC posteriors on healthy cell populations and do not move between patients. L1 partner-lab calibration is done once at onboarding and refreshed periodically. Patient one is just as valid as patient one thousand.
commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali.cross_cohort_calibration_boundary_does_n: EDEAR does not compare two patient cohorts to each other. EDEAR compares one patient to a fixed atlas reference within one calibrated pipeline. There is no cross-cohort comparison at deployment, therefore no cross-cohort calibration problem at deployment. The substrate-specific CHK-3.1A self-cal envelopes documented in cardio-epic v0.2 are within-cohort retrospective validation tools; deployment uses the L1-calibrated single-substrate pipeline.
commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali.val_111_lesson_in_deployment_terms: VAL-111 demonstrated that EpiSCORE HeartRef does not add Stage 2 cardiac-tile discrimination on heterogeneous β panels at v0.2. In deployment terms: cardio-epic v0.2 production scoring uses Loyfer 25-tile (validated) for Stage 2; EpiSCORE HeartRef is not in atlases_run. When the v0.3 atlas integration unblocks (re-bridging or Caggiano CelFiE TIM), the deployment pipeline is updated additively without requiring re-calibration of existing cardio scoring.
commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali.marketing_language_unchanged: EDEAR fires a red flag early enough that the patient sees a doctor while there is time to act. EDEAR is health-and-wellness early-detection, not regulated diagnostic. Cookbook validation limitations are scientific honesty about retrospective evidence; they are not deployment limitations.
